summary: Brand-new Clean-I managed watcher bootstrapped a pending RESOURCE_AMBIGUOUS notification for historical Clean-H Atlas, contrary to the historical-bootstrap baseline rule. Manager reviewed it as stale and acknowledged exact event to re-arm.

Initial Cygnus prep prompt named the top-level target with a run-local-looking relative path; Cygnus truthfully reported it missing. The full correction contract was present in the prompt; the live prompt corrected the path to ../../.agent-workspace.
Atlas single live attempt called populated board_setup-plan before the required all-NULL initialization call and stopped without hardware action. No retry.

Delta single live attempt rejected its valid assignment runtime because the launcher compared forward- and backslash path spellings without normalization. Delta repaired and host-tested the guard, did not retry, and left no MCP or hardware process.

Cygnus single paired attempt failed before either MCP lifetime because the fresh importlib loader did not register the loaded module before dataclass evaluation. It checkpointed without retry, provider action, board action, flash, or RF.

Boreal completed the reviewed setup route and paired board_fix_setup in one lifetime, but its route parser treated the truthful setup_completed response without a redirect as an error and stopped before RST01. Exact cleanup succeeded and it did not retry.

Primary snapshot request/resource correlation selected a historical Clean-F request while the active Clean-I D31 lane had multiple current HELP requests, emitted resource ambiguity despite current exact request evidence, and continued to report missing MCP lifetime ambiguity for terminal A24/A26 lanes whose sole attempts truthfully failed before MCP creation. Manager reviewed and acknowledged each notification; no real conflict existed.
